evidence: Current builder writes grain and pair scope but no evidence_semantics_version or motion_schema_version.
scientific_consequence: Native evidence cannot be bound unambiguously to formula and tensor semantics.
recommended_resolution: Add explicit versions to output, audit, gate and lineage hashes.

evidence: The current five-group authority validates exact ordered names, dimensions, dtype, masks, versions and SHA-256 across producer declaration, exporter, sidecar, loader and model preflight.
scientific_consequence: Tensor dimension and feature meaning can change silently.
recommended_resolution: Create one ordered schema and fail on missing, order, duplicate or extra columns.

evidence: _add_temporal_deltas fills invalid pair-derived columns with numeric zero.
scientific_consequence: Unavailable pairs can be interpreted as measured rest and bias statistics.
recommended_resolution: Retain unavailable values until masked aggregation and export explicit availability.

evidence: Required pair coverage fields are not produced by the current native evidence builder.
scientific_consequence: Zero output cannot be distinguished from no valid evidence.
recommended_resolution: Export counts, ratios and no-valid-pair availability mask.

evidence: Phase 2 emits explicit tangential acceleration and retains the old scalar name only as a pre-v2 compatibility alias.
scientific_consequence: Tangential acceleration is mislabeled as general acceleration.
recommended_resolution: Rename tangential feature and add vector components/magnitude.

evidence: Phase 2 producer emits ax, ay and vector magnitude using consecutive midpoint-timed interval-average velocities.
scientific_consequence: Turning at constant speed has false zero acceleration under scalar-speed derivative.
recommended_resolution: Implement ax, ay and Euclidean vector magnitude with explicit validity.

evidence: Phase 3 emits separate axis and diagonal metric IDs, versions, formulas, masks and threshold bindings.
scientific_consequence: Resolved for implemented image-coordinate features; physical-distance claims remain forbidden.
recommended_resolution: Version metric names and bind thresholds without changing calibrated values silently.

evidence: Phase 3 continuity compares canonical nearest_partner_key and resets by actor/temporal unit.
scientific_consequence: Resolved for implemented social continuity; pig_id remains metadata only.
recommended_resolution: Emit canonical partner key and use it for all temporal continuity.

evidence: Phase 3 includes direct equal-distance and arbitrary row-permutation regression tests.
scientific_consequence: Resolved by canonical distance/key ordering and permutation tests.
recommended_resolution: Add equal-distance and row-permutation tests using canonical partner key.

evidence: Phase 3 recomputes contact/availability counts and divides contact by ROI-available frames.
scientific_consequence: Resolved with explicit zero-availability mask and observed-frame availability ratio.
recommended_resolution: Use ROI-available denominator and explicit zero-availability mask.

evidence: Phase 4 implements canonical semantic domains, stage code hashes, a 17-stage dependency graph, stale-artifact classification and earliest rebuild computation.
scientific_consequence: Resolved for machine detection and release preflight; no official artifact was regenerated or authorized.
recommended_resolution: Add dependency-aware semantic hash invalidation gate.

evidence: No authoritative end-to-end tracking-quality missingness predicate was identified.
scientific_consequence: Quality failure may be conflated with geometry, Hidden or modality availability.
recommended_resolution: Review and version tracking-quality policy independently of Hidden.

evidence: No calibrated world-plane distance feature is active.
scientific_consequence: Physical distance, metres and metres/second claims are unsupported.
recommended_resolution: Keep as future calibrated modality; do not relabel image metrics.

evidence: All three existing social-context tests fail with KeyError temporal_unit_key in _add_social_context_columns at starting SHA.
scientific_consequence: The helper contract is inconsistent with frame-local social fixtures and current regression suite.
recommended_resolution: Resolve helper input contract in the later implementation-remediation task and restore the three baseline tests.
